lines.en: label nikigenmorning:
I tap on Niki's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Niki 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Yo. Are you too busy and cool or whatever to make time for me this morning?
lines.zh: : 哟。你今天早上是太忙太酷还是怎么的，没空理我？

lines.en: : Are you able to ask me out to breakfast {i}without{/i} being a condescending dick or is that a thing I should just give up on?
lines.zh: : 你能不能{i}不带{/i}那副居高临下的欠揍样约我吃早饭，还是说这事我该直接放弃？

lines.en: : I'm honestly surprised you haven't given up already.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我挺惊讶你还没放弃。

lines.en: : Ugh...fine. Yeah, whatever. But I don't want to go to that stupid sausage place again.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。行，随便。但我不想去那家破香肠店了。

lines.en: : I'll meet you at the sausage place in half an hour.
lines.zh: : 半小时后香肠店见。

lines.en: : I just fucking told you-
lines.zh: : 我他妈刚跟你说了——

lines.en: I hang up the phone and make my way to the sausage place, Niki's favorite restaurant.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，往香肠店去——那是 Niki 最喜欢的餐馆。

lines.en: scene black
scene nikigenmorning
: I fucking hate you so much.
lines.zh: : 我真是他妈的恨死你了。

lines.en: : You look really attractive right now. I love girls who can handle a sausage.
lines.zh: : 你现在看起来真好看。我就喜欢能对付香肠的女孩。

lines.en: : And I love {i}men{/i} who don't force cute girls into not cute places!
lines.zh: : 我也喜欢{i}不{/i}把可爱女孩硬拖到不可爱的地方的{i}男人{/i}！

lines.en: : Hey, in all fairness, I never would have found out about this place if it wasn't for you.
lines.zh: : 嘿，说句公道话，要不是你，我根本不会发现这地方。

lines.en: : Now shut up and eat your sausage.
lines.zh: : 现在闭嘴，吃你的香肠。

lines.en: : Say {i}sausage{/i} one more time. I dare you.
lines.zh: : 你再说一次{i}香肠{/i}试试。我挑战你。

lines.en: I wind up saying {i}sausage{/i} several more times and nothing bad ever happens.
lines.zh: 结果我又说了好几次{i}香肠{/i}，什么事都没发生。

lines.en: In fact, Niki winds up almost finishing her entire serving and the two of us are left to continue bickering until Kaori asks us to leave the restaurant.
lines.zh: 事实上，Niki 几乎把自己那份全吃完了，我俩继续斗嘴，直到 Kaori 请我们离开餐馆。

lines.en: scene black
Niki puts her mask and sunglasses back on and the two of us take to walking around the city for a little while.
lines.zh: Niki 重新戴好口罩和墨镜，我俩在城里走了一会儿。

lines.en: It's kind of surreal being out and about with someone who has to hide their identity.
lines.zh: 跟一个必须隐藏身份的人一起在外面晃，感觉有点超现实。

lines.en: But, in a sense, I'm constantly hiding my whereabouts as well since it would be quite troublesome if some girls just always knew where I was.
lines.zh: 但从某种意义上说，我也一直在隐藏自己的行踪——要是某些女孩总能知道我在哪儿，那就太麻烦了。

lines.en: We're not able to do much since Niki has other places she needs to be, but the time we {i}do{/i} spend with one another feels surprisingly natural.
lines.zh: Niki 还有别的地方要去，我们做不了太多事，但真正待在一起的那段时间，意外地自然。

lines.en: In fact, I don't know why that's surprising at all to me at this point.
lines.zh: 其实到了这个地步，我也不知道这有什么好意外的。

lines.en: She knows more about me than anyone. Or at least who I was.
lines.zh: 她比任何人都了解我。或者说，了解过去的我。

lines.en: Not that the current me is all that hard to understand, but-
lines.zh: 倒不是说现在的我有多难懂，只是——

lines.en: Well, I guess all that matters is that she can still walk next to me after all this time.
lines.zh: 算了，重要的是过了这么久，她还能走在我旁边。
